column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 24..12.2019
A  Pradeshiya  Sabha  shall  change  an  accounting  policy  only  if  the  change  results  in  the  financial  statements
providing reliable and more relevant information about the effects of transactions, other events or conditions on
the Pradeshiya Sabha’s financial position, or financial performance. Therefore, changes in accounting policies
The  application  of  a  new  accounting  policy  for  transactions,  other  events  or  conditions  that  did  not  occur
previously or were not material is not treated as a change in an accounting policy.
